chapter: Cab Calloway's band, Hadacol and closing reflections
title: Danny performs Save Your Bones for Henry Jones
summary: Milt recalls hearing Save Your Bones for Henry Jones for the first time, and Danny gives a chorus.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: I remember the first time you played "Save Your Bones For Henry Jones" for me, I like to fell out on the floor. I couldn't believe that. Give a chorus of that.
Then I'll wrap this up pretty quickly. Give us a chorus of that.

I can tell you, I remember one lyric you left out there. "We'll have some molasses and get some (?) so we can have something sweet." Now, this is a (?) for me, because I remember it... Oh, this guy's... The things that I remember about Danny I think just probably make my life... We were talking about that today up at the house, Lu, in my room.
